blocks.text: Designed for adaptability, the 2025 Dell Inspiron 14 2-in-1 lets you work and play your way. Its 360° hinge provides the flexibility to switch between tablet, tent, stand, or laptop modes with ease. Powered by AMD Ryzen processors and DDR5 memory, it delivers smooth, responsive performance for any task. With ExpressCharge, you can power up to 80% in just 60 minutes.Operating system: Windows 11 ProSoftware: Free Lifetime Microsoft Office 2024Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 8640HS (Up to 4.9 GHz Max Boost Clock, 16 MB L3 Cache, 6 cores, 12 threads)Graphics: AMD Radeon GraphicsDisplay: 14", Touch, FHD+, WVA, 300 nits, ComfortViewMemory: 16 GB DDR5 RAMStorage: 1 TB (512 GB SSD + 500 GB External Drive)Wireless Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 comboAudio: MaxxAudio Pro with stereo speakersKeyboard: Ice Blue English Backlit Keyboard, Copilot Key, No Numeric KeypadWebcam: Integrated Widescreen FHD (1080p) Webcam with Dual Digital Microphone Array with Temporal Noise Reduction enabledPorts:2x USB Type-C 10Gbps signaling rate (supports Power Delivery and DisplayPort 1.4 ports)2x USB Type-A 5Gbps signaling rate1x HDMI 1.41x Multimedia SD Card Reader1x 3.5mm Universal Audio Jack1x AC smart pinBattery: 4-Cell, 54Whr (Integrated)Color: Ice BlueDimensions (W x D x H): 12.36 x 8.90 x 0.74 inchesWeight: 3.77 lbsAccessory: MarxsolAccessory (6-in-1 USB-C docking station hub, USB extension cord, HDMI cable, mouse pad, wireless mouse, and 500GB external drive)

items: 【16GB DDR5 RAM + 1TB Storage (512GB SSD + 500GB Ext)】Reams of high-bandwidth 16GB DDR5 RAM to smoothly run your games and video-editing applications, as well as numerous programs and browser tabs all at once. Get up to 15x faster performance than a traditional hard drive with 512GB PCIe NVMe SSD. Enjoy additional portable storage with 500GB external drive.

【AMD Ryzen 5 8640HS Processor】Up to 4.9GHz Max Boost Clock, 16 MB L3 Cache, 6 cores, 12 threads. Wherever your day takes you, the latest AMD Ryzen 8000 Series processors and DDR5 memory power your activities, while the slim design makes it easy to take your laptop along.

【2-IN-1 Design + 14" FHD+ IPS Touch Display】See every detail in stunning Full HD+ with 178° wide-viewing angles. Interact naturally with the 14-inch touchscreen—pinch, zoom, tap, and swipe. The 360° hinge lets you use the laptop in tablet, tent, stand, or traditional laptop mode. Dell 1080p HD camera with dual-array digital microphones ensures clear video and audio.

【Windows 11 Pro Operating System】Windows 11 Pro delivers a powerful, streamlined user experience that helps you stay focused and get more done – wherever your office might be. Safeguard data and access anywhere with hardware-based isolation, encryption, and malware protection built in. For Home, Student, Professionals, Small Business, School Education, and Commercial Enterprise.

【Authorized Accessory】Bonus add-ons includes 6-in-1 USB-C Docking Station Hub (with USB 3.0, 4K-HDMI, USB C Connection, SD/TF Card Reader), HDMI cable, USB cable, mouse pad, wireless mouse, and 500GB portable external drive for your daily work and life. Free lifetime Microsoft Office included. Online Class, Google Classroom, Remote Learning, Zoom Ready.
